models.name: DMV CNN — 12h flood warning (hourly)
models.description: Two-branch 1D CNN trained per gauge on 3 years of hourly USGS streamflow + Open-Meteo ERA5 forcings. Input: past 24h flow + precip + temp + next 12h precip forecast. Output: 12-hour-ahead flow trajectory. CPU-friendly, ~90s training per gauge.
